notes: Not automated: [On Play] Add up to 1 {Revolutionary Army} type Character card from your hand to the top of your Life cards face-up. Then, if you have 2 or more Life cards, add 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards to your hand.

abilities.text: [Trigger] If your Leader is multicolored, draw 2 cards.
